lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: It is a lovely sunny day, and Peppa and George are riding their bicycles.
lines.zh: 今天阳光明媚，佩奇和乔治在骑他们的自行车。

lines.en: That's a fine pumpkin, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，这南瓜真不错。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is very proud of his pumpkin.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸为他的南瓜感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: Pumpkins are the only thing I can grow. Probably because I love pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 南瓜是我唯一能种出来的东西。大概是因为我太喜欢南瓜派了。

lines.en: Come on, George.
lines.zh: 快点，乔治。

lines.en: Peppa and her friends, Danny Dog, Suzy Sheep, and Rebecca Rabbit are riding their bicycles.
lines.zh: 佩奇和她的朋友们，小狗丹尼、小羊苏西和小兔瑞贝卡在骑自行车。

lines.en: George is riding his tricycle. He's going so slowly.
lines.zh: 乔治骑着他的三轮车。他骑得好慢。

lines.en: Let's race to Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
lines.zh: 我们比赛骑到猪爸爸的南瓜那儿去吧。

lines.en: If we race to Daddy's pumpkin, we have to be very careful not to bump into it. Daddy would be very sad if the pumpkin got broken.
lines.zh: 如果我们要骑到爸爸的南瓜那儿，就得非常小心别撞到它。要是南瓜坏了，爸爸会很伤心的。

lines.en: Don't worry, Peppa. Race you!
lines.zh: 别担心，佩奇。我们来比赛！

lines.en: Peppa and her friends are racing to Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
lines.zh: 佩奇和她的朋友们正朝猪爸爸的南瓜骑去。

lines.en: Hey, watch out for my pumpkin!
lines.zh: 嘿，小心我的南瓜！

lines.en: Peppa, look out! Daddy's pumpkin! Sorry, Daddy.
lines.zh: 佩奇，小心！爸爸的南瓜！对不起，爸爸。

lines.en: Look at George. He's going so slowly. George is still riding a baby bike.
lines.zh: 看看乔治。他骑得好慢。乔治还在骑小孩子骑的车。

lines.en: Yours is a baby bike, too, Peppa. You've still got stabilizers.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你的也是小孩子骑的车。你车上还有辅助轮呢。

lines.en: I can ride without my stabilizers. Me, too. And me.
lines.zh: 我可以不用辅助轮骑车。我也可以。还有我。

lines.en: Let's ride up the hill again. Are you coming, Peppa?
lines.zh: 我们再骑上山去吧。你来吗，佩奇？

lines.en: No, I think I'll stay here. See you later. Bye.
lines.zh: 不，我想留在这儿。待会儿见。再见。

lines.en: Peppa wishes she did not have stabilizers on her bicycle.
lines.zh: 佩奇真希望自己的自行车上没有辅助轮。

lines.en: Daddy, I don't want stabilizers anymore. Do you think you can ride without them? Yes.
lines.zh: 爸爸，我不想要辅助轮了。你觉得你能不用它们骑车吗？能。

lines.en: All right, Peppa. Let's take them off.
lines.zh: 好吧，佩奇。我们把它们拆下来。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is taking the stabilizers off Peppa's bicycle.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸正在把佩奇自行车上的辅助轮拆下来。

lines.en: Are you sure you want to ride without stabilizers? Yes. You've never done it before.
lines.zh: 你确定要不用辅助轮骑吗？确定。你以前可从没试过。

lines.en: I can do it. I can. I can.
lines.zh: 我能行。我能行。我能行。

lines.en: It's not funny. Riding without stabilizers is not easy.
lines.zh: 这不好笑。不用辅助轮骑车可不容易。

lines.en: Would you like some help, Peppa? Yes, please, Daddy.
lines.zh: 佩奇，需要帮忙吗？好的，麻烦你，爸爸。

lines.en: All right, ready, steady, go. Don't let go, Daddy. Don't worry, I've got you.
lines.zh: 好了，各就各位，预备，开始。爸爸，别松手。别担心，我扶着你呢。

lines.en: You're doing really well, Peppa. Hold on, Daddy. Just keep pedaling.
lines.zh: 你做得非常好，佩奇。抓紧，爸爸。继续踩踏板。

lines.en: Peppa is riding on her own without stabilizers.
lines.zh: 佩奇自己骑起来了，没有用辅助轮。

lines.en: Daddy, you let go! You've been cycling on your own for ages.
lines.zh: 爸爸，你松手了！你已经自己骑了好久了。

lines.en: Have I? You're really very good at it. Am I?
lines.zh: 是吗？你真的很擅长骑车。我真的行吗？

lines.en: Oh, I can do it! Look at me. Look at me. I can ride my bike properly.
lines.zh: 哦，我会骑了！看着我。看着我。我能好好骑车了。

lines.en: Danny, Suzy, Rebecca, look. I don't need my stabilizers anymore. Look at me!
lines.zh: 丹尼、苏西、瑞贝卡，快看。我不再需要辅助轮了。看着我！

lines.en: Hooray. Race you to Daddy's pumpkin!
lines.zh: 太好啦。我们比赛骑到爸爸的南瓜那儿！

lines.en: Peppa, look out! My pumpkin! I'm going to win. Peppa isn't looking where she's going.
lines.zh: 佩奇，小心！我的南瓜！我要赢了。佩奇根本没看路。

lines.en: Oh dear. Peppa has squashed Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。佩奇把猪爸爸的南瓜压扁了。

lines.en: Sorry I squashed your pumpkin, Daddy.
lines.zh: 对不起，爸爸，我把你的南瓜压扁了。

lines.en: Never mind the pumpkin. The important thing is that you are okay.
lines.zh: 南瓜没关系。重要的是你没事。

lines.en: In future, you really must look where you are going. I promise I will, Daddy.
lines.zh: 以后你真的要看清楚路。我保证我会的，爸爸。

lines.en: Good. Anyway, now the pumpkin is broken, I can make it into pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 很好。反正南瓜已经坏了，我可以把它做成南瓜派。

lines.en: I love pumpkin pie. And because Daddy Pig's pumpkin is so big, there will be enough pumpkin pie for everyone.
lines.zh: 我喜欢南瓜派。而且猪爸爸的南瓜这么大，够大家每人分一份南瓜派了。

lines.en: Hooray.
lines.zh: 太好啦。
